description: Check JSON against a JSON Schema and get every error with its JSON Pointer path. Send the JSON either as text ("input"; broken text is repaired first, and the fixes are listed) or as an already-parsed value ("data"). Optional coerce converts "42" → 42, "true" → true, etc. toward the schema's types before validating and lists each change. A schema mismatch is a normal result (valid: false), not an error. Drafts 2020-12 (default), 2019-09, 7, 4; only local $refs. Pure computation: read-only, no network access, inputs not stored. Same engine and limits as POST /api/v1/validate.

coerce.description: Convert values toward the schema's declared types before validating: "42" → 42, "true" → true, "null" → null, 5 → "5", x → [x]. Each change is listed in coercions.

data.description: An already-parsed JSON value to validate. Send this or "input", not both.

draft.description: JSON Schema draft. Default: from the schema's $schema, else 2020-12.

input.description: JSON text to validate (repaired first if broken). Send this or "data", not both. Max 102,400 bytes.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 by default; 2019-09, 7 and 4 also supported). Only local $refs (#/...) resolve; remote $refs are an error. Max 32 KB.

name: validate_json

errorCount.description: Total errors (at most 50 are listed); a lower bound when errorsTruncated is true

path.description: JSON Pointer to the failing value ("" = root)

errorsTruncated.description: true when the validator produced more than 5,000 raw errors and only the first 5,000 were examined

json.description: The validated value (after repair and coercion)

repaired.description: true when "input" needed repair before validation

title: Validate JSON against a JSON Schema (repairs broken input first)
